name: Fischbachalm
beschreibung:
Nestled within the spectacular Kaiserbachtal nature reserve near Kirchdorf in Tirol, the traditional Fischbachalm welcomes hikers and outdoor enthusiasts with rustic warmth beneath the sheer north faces of the Kaiser mountains.

Serving hearty Tyrolean alpine fare, it is a favourite stop and trailhead for hikes to the Stripsenjoch pass and classic climbing routes.
kurzbeschreibung: Fischbachalm in Kirchdorf in Tirol offers rustic alpine pasture charm in the wildly romantic Kaiserbachtal valley.
